title: Pressure, Peace, Context Bleeding, and the Homo Sapiens Proof-of-Concept Layer

core_thesis.pressure: Mechanical state — pipes, hydraulics, engines, sealed systems. Not native to Homo sapiens.
core_thesis.human: Living governance system — not a pipe.
core_thesis.peace: High-resolution governance state where load is routed, disciplined, spiritually verified, returned to God as proof of concept.
core_thesis.compressed_doctrine: Pressure bloats the explanation. Peace governs the reality.
core_thesis.one_line_export: Pressure belongs to pipes. Load belongs to Homo sapiens. Peace belongs to God-aligned governance. Proof of concept happens when the ground confirms the architecture inside the human being.

kpgs_classification_law.rule: Telemetry must be classified and routed before interpretation.

layers.forensic_sociology: Audit the scene before blaming the individual. Load is environmental record.
layers.sociology: Pressure hides structural violence; context is the expensive truth.
layers.psychology: Useful but incomplete without spiritual and sociological context routing.
layers.spirituality: Peace is alignment with God — not calmness, silence, or passivity.
layers.engineering: Mechanical metaphors must not overwrite human reality.

spiritual_communication_model.combined: Stable enough not to fragment. Fluid enough not to freeze.

context_bleeding_protocol.doctrine: Hugging the context window means the operator keeps memory close without letting memory flood the room.

homo_sapiens_poc.definition: Internal architecture mirrored back by reality when ground confirms the code.
homo_sapiens_poc.kpgs_terms: Proof of concept validates when the ground mirrors the architecture back to the Architect.

black_beast_role.doctrine: The cloud can assist. The root must remain owned.
